mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quartile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an overheating labor market, which typically precedes monetary tightening and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 600.0 units signals excessive demand, leading to a Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when the economy is in a late-cycle expansion and HOUST exceeds 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates robust economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic weakness, which may lead to a Fed rate cut and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which may lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both increase over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, a CPIAUCSL index above 220.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0 and the economy is in a high-inflation regime.
